faq.q: Is champagne included in the price?

data.body_html:
Book a Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas 2032 and watch the sun drop behind La Concha from the deck of a private motor yacht. This evening sail departs Puerto Banús at 19:00, returns at 21:00, and includes a bottle of cava or champagne, light tapas, and a full drinks package. Prices start at €749 for two hours on a Tier A boat (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39), with skipper, fuel, insurance, and 21% IVA all included. No hidden extras, no crowds — just your group and the Mediterranean at dusk.

For a full list of available vessels and pricing, see our boat rental Marbella hub.

Why choose a sunset cruise in Marbella

Marbella's south-facing coastline means you get direct sunset views over the water from May to October. The Golden Mile, the Sierra Blanca, and the silhouette of La Concha create a backdrop that changes colour every minute. A two-hour window from 19:00 to 21:00 gives you the golden hour, the actual sunset, and the first stars — all without rushing.

Unlike a day charter, the evening sail is cooler, quieter, and more intimate. The sea breeze drops, the crowds thin out, and you can anchor off Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim stop if the light permits.

What’s included in the sunset charter

  • Licensed skipper – English and Spanish speaking
  • Fuel and insurance – no extra costs
  • Champagne or cava – one bottle per booking
  • White wine, beer, soft drinks, water – unlimited throughout
  • Light tapas snacks – olives, nuts, cured meats, cheeses, bread
  • Safety equipment – life jackets, first aid, fire extinguisher
  • 21% IVA (VAT) – included in the price

Which boats are available for the sunset cruise

The sunset cruise is offered on our Tier A boats, both based at Puerto Banús:

BoatLengthMax paxPrice (2h)
Astondoa 4012.5m9€749
Azimut 3912.5m11€749

Both boats have a shaded cockpit, a small galley, and a bow sunpad area. If you have a larger group, consider a 4-hour charter on a Tier B boat like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, from €4,719 for 4h including a jet ski). Ask via WhatsApp for availability.

Typical sunset cruise itinerary

  1. 19:00 – Board at Puerto Banús, meet your skipper, safety briefing
  2. 19:15 – Departure, head west along the coast past the Golden Mile
  3. 19:30–20:15 – Anchor off Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for swimming and sunset photos
  4. 20:15–20:45 – Cruise back, drinks and tapas served, watch the sun set
  5. 21:00 – Return to Puerto Banús

This is a flexible route — your skipper can adjust based on weather and your preferences. If you want to head east towards Cabopino or south towards the open sea, just ask.

Best time of year for a sunset cruise in Marbella

Sunset times in Marbella range from 18:15 in December to 21:45 in June. Our 19:00–21:00 slot works well from April to October, when the sun sets after 20:00. In summer (June–August), you get a full golden hour from 20:30 onwards, with the sky turning pink and orange until 21:30. In spring and autumn, the light is softer and the sea is calmer.

Average sea temperature in summer is 24–26°C, so a swim stop is comfortable. Bring a light jacket for the evening breeze.

How to book your Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas 2032

Booking is simple: contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and any special requests (e.g., dietary requirements, extra decorations for a proposal or birthday). We’ll confirm availability and send you a payment link for the deposit (typically 50%). The balance is due on the day of the cruise, payable in cash or card.

For pricing on other boats or longer charters, check our Marbella boat rental page or message us directly. We recommend booking at least one week in advance during peak season (July–August).

Frequently asked questions

What time does the sunset cruise depart?

The sunset cruise departs at 19:00 from Puerto Banús and returns at 21:00, giving you the best light for the golden hour and sunset. Times may shift slightly in summer or winter depending on actual sunset.

Which boats are used for the sunset cruise?

The sunset cruise is typically on our Tier A boats: the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both are comfortable motor yachts with shaded cockpit areas and bow seating.

Is champagne included in the price?

Yes, a bottle of cava or champagne is included per booking, along with white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water. Light tapas-style snacks are also served on board.

Can I bring my own food or drinks?

You're welcome to bring extra snacks or drinks if you wish, but our standard package already includes drinks and tapas. No corkage fee applies.

What happens if the weather is bad?

If the captain deems conditions unsafe due to wind or sea state, we'll reschedule your cruise for another evening or offer a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely.

Is the sunset cruise suitable for children?

Yes, children are welcome. The boat has safety equipment and a licensed skipper. Note that alcohol is included but non-alcoholic options are also available.

How do I book the Marbella sunset cruise?

You can book via WhatsApp on the contact number listed on our site. We require a deposit to confirm, with the balance due on the day of the cruise.

Can I extend the sunset cruise to a longer charter?

Yes, you can upgrade to a 4-hour or 8-hour charter. For example, the Tier A boats cost €1,299 for 4 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Just ask via WhatsApp.
